title: Abelian inverse-image presentations on small affine etale algebraic-space models
statement: For algebraic spaces over a scheme [def-trf-algebraic-space], use the existing small affine etale model and its inclusion [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], and the enlarged etale site and fibre-product direct image [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Define restriction of abelian sheaves, with coefficients in the original universe u, along the affine inclusion and the scheme inclusion. Both restriction functors are equivalences; retain the equivalences with these precise forward functors. Define the abelian direct image of a space morphism f by conjugating evaluation on the enlarged-site fibre products through these equivalences. Its chart section map is restriction along the actual chart-to-fibre-product arrow followed by the two restriction counits. Use Mathlib's small Ext construction from enough injectives on the small affine site. An abelian inverse-image presentation consists of an additive exact left adjoint P to this specified direct image, with its adjunction, and an isomorphism from the source constant integer sheaf to P of the target integer sheaf. Require this isomorphism to send 1 on every source affine chart to the unit image of 1 on every compatible target chart, restricted by the specified chart section map. The local inverse-image section map is the adjunction unit followed by that chart section map. Define pullback on global cohomology as exact-functor transport on Ext followed by precomposition with this integer isomorphism, using the existing integer sheaves and global Ext cohomology [def-sfb-ringed-site-picard-data]. No arbitrary coefficient or cohomology map is part of this definition; existence of an inverse-image presentation is not asserted here.
